data.name: Drift For Life
data.detailed_description:
Drift For Life is a pure arcade drifting game focused on maintaining control while drifting at high speeds. The goal is simple but demanding: achieve the highest score by keeping your drift chains alive.

Every corner is an opportunity to multiply your score. Longer drifts, clean transitions, and uninterrupted combos reward you with higher points. The game features easy-to-learn but hard-to-master arcade driving mechanics that test your reflexes and car control.

With split-screen support, you can compete with friends on the same screen and instantly prove who the better drifter is. The score-focused gameplay encourages you to push your limits and break your own records every run.

Drift For Life delivers a pure and exciting drifting experience designed for players who love speed, control, and competition.Drift For Life is a pure arcade drifting game focused on maintaining control while drifting at high speeds. pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 2600, Core i5-8600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 570, GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600, Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX5700 (8GB), GeForce RTX 2070 (8GB)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
